instruction: Inspect `topside.brd` in EAGLE. Start EAGLE from `/opt/eagle-7.7.0/bin/eagle` and open `topside.brd` there. Every SMD component currently sits on the Top side. Flip the entire board to the Bottom side and save the result as `/home/user/Desktop/answer.brd`. Requirements: 1. `/home/user/Desktop/answer.brd` remains a parseable EAGLE board XML file. 2. The board keeps the same number of `<element>` entries as the starter. 3. Every `<element>` is mirrored to the Bottom side, so its `rot` attribute begins with `M`. 4. Each element keeps the same `x` and `y` coordinates as in the starter board. 5. The `<signals>` block keeps the same number of signals as the starter. Do not delete the `<signals>`, `<libraries>`, or `<layers>` sections.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(8); w, h = pyautogui.size(); pyautogui.click(w/2 + 100, h/2 + 25); time.sleep(2); pyautogui.click(w/2 + 213, h/2 + 146); time.sleep(2); pyautogui.click(w/2 - 80, h/2 + 68); time.sleep(5)
